summary: DeFi Technologies Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release announcing that its subsidiary Valour Inc. and Valour Digital Securities Limited launched the Valour Zcash (ZEC) SEK ETP. The product began trading on the Spotlight Stock Market on September 29, 2026 under ISIN CH1108681763, carrying a 1.9% management fee, and expands Valour's platform to more than 100 digital asset ETPs. This is an ordinary product-launch current report, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
